title: Week 44: Processes, Zygote, Binder, and System Services Checkpoint

questions.prompt: Checkpoint: What is the security-relevant distinction between UID and PID?
questions.explanation: The UID identifies the app sandbox and permissions, while a PID identifies one temporary running process instance. The conclusion must remain connected to the correct owner and version-matched evidence.
options: Model PID as ephemeral execution, UID as security identity, threads as shared-memory execution, and persist state needed after process death.
questions.answer: Model PID as ephemeral execution, UID as security identity, threads as shared-memory execution, and persist state needed after process death.
